page.overview:
Who is Ihor?

Ihor was a soldier of House Harkonnen and the bodyguard of Myr Charki.

Ihor arrived on Arrakis as part of a patrol of troopers from House Harkonnen. Myr Charki offered them a place to sleep one night. During the night, the rest of the patrol left, with Ihor remaining behind. Chakri made Ihor his silent partner, with him handling the business while Ihor handled the fighting. Ihor never spoke, though whether this was due to an inability or by choice is unknown.

Ihor was standing guard with Chakri when he was approached by the Prisoner at the Griffin's Reach Tradepost.
